evidence.citation: "Stop before running any evaluation... resolve the eval mode with the user... Only begin blind runs once every case has a concrete, judgeable bar and the mode is settled."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact requires clarifying the evaluation mode and establishing a concrete, judgeable bar before spending runs. Under the supplied bar, that is necessary setup work to validate the requested outcome and avoid unguided or mis-scoped evaluation, not materially unnecessary execution work.
